name: Dating your Dream
source:
Susie wants to go to the prom with Mathew. However, she has some choices to make. Should she take Mathew to the beach, the park, or just get a job where he works? You make the choices and see the outcome!

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/datingdream.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
苏西想和马修一起去参加舞会。然而，她需要做出一些选择。她应该带马修去海滩、公园，还是只是在他工作的地方找一份工作？你做出选择并看到结果！

[来自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/datingdream.html]宅男世界[/url]]
